thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Dedicated pool "acme-vpc-pool" gpu_util=100% pending_queue=1024 p99_token_latency=4.5s https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/pool/acme-vpc-pool
Nate: oncall, ack. Paging eng-runtime + customer-success. ETA 1m.
ops-bot: runbook started -> runbooks/dedicated_pools/exhaustion.md
Maria (cust-success): Acme SRE says several customer requests are timing out; they see 502s from gateway since 07:12 UTC.
Ajay (eng-runtime): digging; looks like a single tenant flood: tenant=acme-vpc job=bulk-embedder_2026 batch=12000
eng-runtime: log dump:
```
2026-03-15T07:11:58Z tenant=acme-vpc job=bulk-embedder batch_size=12000 enqueue=12000 kv_miss=0.88
```
Dana (cs): DM with Acme: they can pause but job is kicked off by a scheduled pipeline.
Ajay: autoscaler blocked due to contract cap 20 gpus for this dedicated pool. No burst configured.
Nate: quick mitigations: ask pause, admission throttle, route fallback, temporary burst from shared.
Ajay: we can set per-tenant admission via:
```
rwctl rate set --tenant acme-vpc --concurrency 5 --mode=reject
```
Nate: apply it now.
ops-bot: admission policy applied tenant=acme-vpc concurrency=5 mode=reject
Ajay: prepping fallback: route ~30% of non-enterprise traffic to tiny-model-quant for 30m:
```
routerctl split --from=acme-vpc-pool --to=tiny-model-quant --pct=30 --match 'tier!=enterprise'
```
ops-bot: split queued; >10% requires ops approval.
Nate: approving 30% emergency split for 25m.
ops-bot: split enacted: 28% traffic rerouted
Maria: Acme SRE confirms pause at 07:18 UTC and can cancel queued runs.
Ajay: queue dropped 1024 -> 140 after admission+split. GPU util -> ~70%.
Nate: Acme requested a one-time +10 gpu burst; legal/contract limits prevent autoscale beyond 20 gpus. They agree to pay overage.
cto-lead: approve one-time +10gpus for up to 45m if invoiced and other tenants protected.
ops-head: approve. Ops, attempt allocation.
ops-bot: allocate --from=global-spare --to=acme-vpc-pool --gpus=10 --ttl=2700
ops-bot: allocation failed -> insufficient regional quota us-east-1
Ajay: can we reassign capacity from low-priority demo pools in us-east-1?
ops-head: yes, preempt demo-pool-7 (4 gpus) and demo-pool-2 (3 gpus) -> total 7 reclaimed, still need 3.
ops-bot: attempting hosted spare for remaining 3 -> success. Audit INC-247502.
ops-bot: burst applied: +10 gpus TTL=45m. Annotated audit: INC-247502
eng-runtime: nodes registered; pool is now 30 gpus. Monitor.
Nate: monitoring... queue 18, gpu_util 58%, p99 latency trending down.
Maria: Acme resumed and will throttle scheduler. They've asked for incident report and billing estimate.
Ajay: follow-ups: add alert: single-tenant QPS >50% & batch_size >4k, and add soft batch-size limit at runtime for bulk endpoints.
Dana: capturing customer permission to invoice; adding transcript to ticket.
Nate: marking mitigated at 07:36 UTC. Handing postmortem to Lina.
incident-bot: INC-247502 MITIGATED by Nate @ 07:36 UTC
Nate: Lina, handing off incident ownership for postmortem + customer write-up.
Lina: acknowledged. I'll own PM, schedule follow-up, and close action items.
Action items: Maria -> customer meeting + billing details; Product -> evaluate burst add-on; Eng-runtime -> patch to autoscaler and soft caps; Ops -> update runbook with region quota checks and preemption checklist.
